title: From kimchi to malatang, tomatoes take on new flavors in Korea
caption:
From spicy malatang to experimental kimchi, Korea is finding new ways to cook with tomatoes. It’s moving far beyond the childhood snack of sugar-dusted slices.

Source: Koreaherald - From kimchi to malatang, tomatoes take on new flavors in Korea
